answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the saffron until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work.
